title: For those who no longer wish to dream of mallworld (for any reason)
content: Just throwing this out there for anyone finding themselves in shared dream spaces that seem less than lovely, repeating this affirmation before sleep actually seems to have solved it for me. Best if recited as part of your affirmation with the gateway tapes (i.e. "Exploration Sleep"): I am the only authority in my field. I revoke all unconscious agreements, past or present. I call back all my energy, across all time and space. I release all attachments that are not mine. My dreaming is my own. My space is clear, my will is free, my path is mine. Sending love and the best of luck to you all <3
